"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Nuclear, biological, and cyber attacks pose the potential for large-scale damage and destruction to people, the economy, and the way of life.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The capacity to inflict damage from nuclear, biological, and cyber attacks is spreading to other countries and potentially to terrorist groups.",
